trigger: A maintainer reads the BASELINE_UNTWINNED history comment in check-api-parity.py to justify the ratchet value.
summary: After the second dev merge the history comments read 212 -> 209 -> 208 (twin batch B) then 212 -> 210 (#4041) and the value is 206. Both histories are true in isolation but no line states the combined step, so the chain cannot be reconstructed from the comments. Also reported as n-cons-1 (consistency-auditor) and noted by security-guardian. Thirteen gates ran (security, docs, cpp-expert, cpp-safety, architect, consistency, happy-path, unhappy-path, quality-engineer, build-ci, sre, compliance, enterprise-readiness); this was the only finding. All thirteen are subagents of the session that authored the merge, so none is an independent closure.
classification_rationale: Comment-only gap in a ratchet history; the constant and the checker are correct (checker OK at 206, selftest OK).
